h1: Custom Fleece Outerwear for Teams & Events
metaDescription: Order custom fleece outerwear for your team or event. Get premium embroidery and screen printing on bulk orders from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Fleece outerwear offers the perfect balance of warmth and breathability for team uniforms, corporate giveaways, and safety incentives. Whether you need quarter-zip pullovers for a sales meeting or full-zip jackets for an outdoor event, fleece provides a soft, comfortable layer that works across seasons. With decoration options like embroidery on the chest or screen printing on the back, your logo stands out clearly on the smooth fabric surface.
heroAltText: Group of people wearing custom fleece outerwear with embroidered logos, including quarter-zip jackets and vests.
